To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the WW mechanism for Higgs production is the dominant one for the Higgs boson masses of 130 GeV and 160 GeV. For the Higgs bosons with masses 110 GeV and 150 GeV the WW mechanism dominates at low energies
the suppression of the double-dif-fractive Higgs signal is about 10% for a Higgs of mass 120 GeV and that the suppression is less for larger mass.
the rapidity gap H → WW → l l l l events will be observable in the 100-300 fb-1 data sample at 7 TeV LHC, and that the inclusive H → WW → ll events should be observable in the same sample.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the double-dif-fractive central production of a HIGGS BOSON at the CERN Large Hadron Collider (LHC), with √ s = 14 TeV and √ s = 10 TeV, respectively.
the double diffractive production of large E _{T} dijets and Higgs bosons.
the double-dif-fractive production of a high mass Higgs boson at LHC energies, with a focus on the “rapidity-gap” Higgs signal.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the WW mechanism dominates over the pomeron-pomeric fusion mechanism in the double diffractive production of the Higgs boson at LHC energies.
the rapidity gap Higg s signal is not a clean signal, but that the inclusive dijet rapidity gap signal is a very clean one, and should be observable with a reasonable luminosity.
the rapidity gap Higg signal at LHC will be a very important discovery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the suppression due to QCD radiation is small, and therefore that the rapidity gap Higgss signal should be observable at LHC.
the leading log approximation is very accurate for the inclusive double-diffracive Higgs production.
the rapidity gap Higgss signal at the LHC is not suppressed by QCD radiation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the suppression factor of the rapidity gap Higg events is not very large.
, for a wide range of parameters, the exclusive pomeron-pomeric Higgs production process is not suppressed relative to WW fusion.
the rapidity gap Higgss signal at LHC is suppressed by about a factor 5 relative to the WW fusion mechanism.
